newsitem.title: CHINA: RESEARCH ALERT - MERRILL CUTS CATHAY PACIFIC EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - MERRILL CUTS CATHAY PACIFIC EPS.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said on Tuesday it has cut earning per share forecasts for Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd by 15 and 20 percent, to HK$0.93 and HK$0.95 for calendar 1997 and 1998, respectively.

"The 3.4 percent decline in the pre-exceptional (interim) net profit to HK$1.07 billion was disappointing and came in the bottom end of analysts' expectations," Wendy Wong, an analyst of Merrill Lynch, said in a recent report.
The Hong Kong flag carrier posted HK$1.07 billion interim net, down 35 percent from HK$1.65 billion the pervious year which had HK$541 million exceptional gains.
An estimated 40 to 50 percent drop in Japanese passenger volumes severely undermined Cathay's revenue growth and the trend would likely continue into the seond half, Wong said.
The shares were currently trading on a cash flow multiple of 8.4 times to 1997 earnings.
This represented a 53 percent premium to the sector average of 5.5 times which seemed very demanding, Wong said.
"We are reiterating our intermediate term reduce rating," she added. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
